it.name: Tripsy: Travel Planner
it.d:
Tripsy is a travel planner and itinerary organizer that brings your flights, hotels, activities, reservations, and travel expenses together in one place.

Build a day-by-day trip itinerary, plan routes between stops, and share your travel plans with family and friends. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a road trip, a business trip, or a vacation across several cities, keep the details organized and your plans close at hand—even offline.

PLAN YOUR DAYS WITH SMART ROUTES
See estimated travel times and distances between activities, with routes that fit your schedule. Set arrival buffers for flights and other plans, and see when your schedule leaves too little travel time. Your transportation choices stay saved and sync across your devices.

BUILD ROUTES WITH MULTIPLE STOPS
Add and reorder stops, choose how to travel on each leg, and see estimated arrival times along the way. View your route on the map and open directions in your preferred navigation app. Save frequently used addresses, such as home, work, or a favorite hotel, to use in future plans.

SMART IMPORT
Turn screenshots, documents, pasted text, Google Maps and Apple Maps lists, and supported web or social links into places and reservations. Review and edit before importing. Smart Import uses online processing and requires Tripsy Pro on supported system versions. You can also forward booking emails or import travel plans from TripIt.

BRING YOUR CALENDARS TOGETHER
See events from your selected calendars alongside your trip itinerary, and add them as activities when needed. Sync your Tripsy itinerary to your calendar to keep travel plans visible in your daily schedule.

PLAN AND TRAVEL TOGETHER
Invite family, friends, or colleagues to collaborate on a trip or follow along with view-only access. Choose who can edit plans and access documents or expenses. Save favorite guests to make planning your next trip together easier.

STAY INFORMED ON THE GO
Receive flight updates for delays, gates, terminals, and baggage claims. Check 10-day weather forecasts, keep track of local time zones, and access your itinerary offline when you don't have a connection.

SMART INSIGHTS
Find baggage, breakfast, parking, and cancellation details from attached documents and emails right in your activities. Review suggested costs before saving. Analysis runs on your device and requires Apple Intelligence.

KEEP YOUR TRAVEL DETAILS CLOSE
Keep reservation emails, documents, photos, links, and notes with your trip. Personalize each trip with a cover image or color.

TRACK EXPENSES AND LOOK BACK ON YOUR TRAVELS
Record travel expenses in multiple currencies, let guests add their own expenses, and keep track of spending throughout your trip. Export itineraries, activity lists, and expenses to CSV. With Tripsy Book, explore your travel statistics, including countries visited, hotel nights, flight time, and distance traveled.

PLAN WITH YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Connect Tripsy to a compatible AI assistant to create trips, add activities, and update your itinerary through conversation.

Tripsy is available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, with cloud sync to keep your trips up to date across your devices.

Tripsy is free to download. Some features require Tripsy Pro, available as a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://tripsy.app/policy

it.name: Wikiloc - Trails of the World
it.d:
Discover millions of outdoor trails around the world. Choose between hiking, running, bike, MTB, kayak, ski or up to 80 different types of activities.

Record your own routes on a map, add waypoints, take pictures along the itinerary and upload them to your Wikiloc account from your phone.

Enjoy free offline topographic maps from all over the world for you to use without coverage or data. Great when you're out in the mountains or traveling without Internet connection.

Want to take your outdoor experiences even further? With Wikiloc Premium:

- Turn your mobile into a GPS navigator. Your smartphone will guide you with a heading indicator and sound alerts to warn you if you go off-track during navigation.
- Route Planner: Choose the places you want to pass through and Wikiloc will create a route prioritizing the most popular stretches of trails from other community members.
- 3D Maps: Without leaving home, discover the terrain relief, evaluate elevation changes, and take a look at the panoramic views that await you along the way.
- Live Tracking. Share your position in real time with your family & friends while doing the route.
- Send to your GPS: Download trails from Wikiloc directly to your Garmin, Apple Watch, Suunto or COROS. Feature available for compatible devices.
- Search by Passing Area: Find trails passing through your chosen specific areas.
- Weather forecast for a perfect outdoor activity.
- Advanced search filters.

By purchasing Wikiloc Premium you’ll be contributing in helping us out to maintain Wikiloc’s infrastructure. 
Furthermore, you’ll also contribute protecting the earth, as 1% of your purchase will directly go to 1% for the Planet, a global network of businesses, nonprofits, and individuals working together for a healthy planet.

Wikiloc Premium is available with a quarterly or annual subscription. 

Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the trial period if applicable. Wikiloc Premium subscriptions automatically renew. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period unless you decide to cancel your subscription renewal at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by going to your user Account Settings after the purchase. For your convenience, we also provide links to manage your subscription from your Wikiloc Profile > Settings, that you can access from both web or app.

Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Wikiloc for Apple Watch uses HealthKit to save your Wikiloc activities into the Health app and to read the heart rate and active energy data. Most popular Wikiloc activities have an equivalent Apple workout and will be saved into the Health app.

Terms of use: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/terms_en.html?v6.0
Privacy policy: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/privacy.html?v4.1

Join us at Wikiloc.com, the community where millions of nature, travel and sports lovers share their adventures, from the most popular excursion to the most remote expedition on the planet.

it.name: Flightradar24 | Flight Tracker
it.d:
The world's best flight tracker app - #1 Travel app in over 150 countries.

Turn your iPhone or iPad into a live flight tracker and see planes around the world move in real-time on a detailed map. Or point your device at a plane to find out where it’s going and what kind of aircraft it is. Download for free today and discover why millions are already tracking flights and checking flight status with Flightradar24.

• Watch aircraft move around the world in real-time
• Identify flights overhead & see flight information—including a photo of the actual aircraft—by simply pointing your device at the sky 
• See what the pilot of an aircraft sees in 3D 
• Tap on a plane for flight details such as route, estimated time of arrival, actual time of departure, aircraft type, speed, altitude, high-resolution photos of the actual aircraft & more.
• See historical data & watch playback of past flights
• Tap on an airport icon for arrival & departure boards, flight status, aircraft on the ground, current delay stats, & detailed weather conditions
• Search and bookmark individual flights using flight number, airport, or airline
• Filter flights by airline, aircraft, altitude, speed, & more
• NEW - view aircraft in 3D with hundreds of new aircraft and airline liveries added.
 
Flightradar24 is a free app and includes all the above features. If you want even more great features from Flightradar24 there are two upgrade options—Silver & Gold—and each comes with a free trial.
 
SILVER

• 90 days of flight history
• More aircraft details, like serial number & age
• More flight details, like vertical speed & squawk
• Filters and alerts to find and track flights

Transform every journey into valuable data with GPS Speedometer - the most comprehensive speed tracking app for driving, cycling, boating, and beyond. Experience professional-grade features that keep you informed and in control.

CORE FEATURES:
- Real-time GPS speed tracking with precision accuracy
- Comprehensive trip computer: speed, distance, altitude, heading, duration
- Trip recording with route tracking
- Live map view with real-time position tracking
- Save and export your journeys

ADVANCED CAPABILITIES:
Picture in Picture Mode (PRO):
- Keep your speed visible while using other apps
- Resizable floating speedometer overlay
- Perfect for navigation or music apps

Heads-Up Display (HUD):
- Project speed onto your windshield for safer driving
- Mirrored display mode for reflection viewing
- Keep eyes on the road while monitoring speed

Road-Based Speed Limits (PRO):
- Automatic speed limit detection for your current road
- Real-time alerts when exceeding limits
- Works worldwide with smart inference technology
- Customizable warning offsets and sounds

Speed Camera Alerts (PRO):
- Warnings for fixed, red light, combined, and section control cameras
- See cameras on the map as you drive
- On-screen banner as you approach
- Live average speed and progress bar inside section control zones
- Pick voice announcements, alert sound, or both
- Powered by the SCDB.info database
- Coverage across Europe, UK, USA, Australia, and Brazil

Performance Metrics:
- G-Force meter tracks acceleration and braking forces
- Enhanced altitude tracking with barometric sensors
- Moving vs. stopped time analysis
- Maximum and average speed calculations

SEAMLESS INTEGRATION:
- Apple Music display and playback controls
- View current song without switching apps
- Control your music while tracking your journey

COMPLETE CUSTOMIZATION:
- Choose units: KM/H, MPH, or Knots
- Multiple display modes and layouts
- Extensive theme selection with custom colors
- Dark/Light mode support
- Adjustable speedometer scale
- Portrait/Landscape with orientation lock
- Left or right-handed speedometer placement

HANDS-FREE & LIVE ACTIVITY:
- Start, stop, and control recording with Siri, Shortcuts, and Control Center (iOS 18)
- See your live speed on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island

PRO SUBSCRIPTION UNLOCKS:
- Unlimited trip saving and recording
- Export routes in GPX format
- Road-based speed limit detection & alerts
- Speed camera alerts with voice and sound
- Picture in Picture mode
- Weather information with forecasts
- Custom app icons
- All themes and colors
- Trip statistics with personal records and streaks

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
- Free to download with core features always free
- Optional PRO subscription for advanced features
- Cancel anytime via App Store settings
- Payment charged to Apple ID at confirmation
- Auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before period ends
- Manage subscriptions in your App Store account settings

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Requires GPS/Location Services for speed tracking
- Not compatible with Wi-Fi-only iPad models
- GPS accuracy varies with signal strength and environment
- Best accuracy in open areas with clear sky view
- Continuous GPS use impacts battery life
- Never interact with device while driving - safety first!

Your feedback helps us improve and add new features.

it.d:
Uncover the mysteries of live air traffic in one beautiful and easy to use app. Is it a bird? Is it a plane?! If it’s the latter, Plane Finder can tell you exactly which plane it is.
 
Plane Finder is incredibly easy to use and utterly fascinating. It enables you to see live air traffic patterns with real-time tracking of almost any plane you’re interested in, and in addition to the aircraft’s location you can see its current altitude, its speed and where it’s heading.
 
Get live information on flights - super handy when travelling. You can even be alerted when a particular flight is heading your way, which is useful if you’re trying to catch sight of rare birds such as the Airbus A380.
 
Switch to incredible 3D flight tracking anytime from any aircraft, airport or location on the map seamlessly to view air traffic as never before.
 
There’s a superb augmented-reality option that enables you to point your camera at the sky and see details of the aircraft that’s overhead, and with full support for iOS’s Dark Mode it’s just as handy for night flights as it is for daytime ones.
 
It’s all great fun, but it’s also very practical: in addition to flight tracking there’s extensive airport information, which supplements live arrival and departures with live weather reports for hundreds of airports.
 
Enjoy Plane Finder’s leading edge design as featured in Apple’s “The Power of Dark Mode” and “See it in Dark Mode” Collections 2019.
 
Apple’s App of The Day – Jan 2020 and Top ranking since 2009. Plane Finder is also featured in Gizmodo, CNN, GMA, BBC, Sunday Times, Mail on Sunday, CNET, Wired, GQ Magazine to name a few.
 
Trusted by friends and families of travellers, enthusiasts, pilots, cabin crew and aviation professionals alike. Choose Plane Finder for:
 
•	Live Global Flight Tracking
Quickly find and track flights live on a map and explore live status information
 
•	Switch to 3D Tracking Anytime
Flip instantly to 3D from any aircraft, airport or location on the map

•	Live AR Mode
Point your camera at a plane in the sky to instantly reveal live flight and aircraft information
 
•	Live Airport Information
View real time airport arrival and departure boards plus terminal, gate, baggage and weather information
 
•	Comprehensive Technical Data
Dig deeper into technical aircraft and flight data
 
•	Unlimited Custom Alerts
Never miss a flight, create as many custom notifications as you like and stay informed
 
•	Unlimited Global Playback
Replay interesting flights and watch fascinating air traffic patterns back to 2011
 
•	Unlimited Filters
Simplify your view with powerful filters
 
•	Custom Aircraft Labels
Choose the position, color and content of aircraft labels inc. logo with text label
 
•	Leading Edge Dark Mode
Adopt dark mode, a bold interface perfect for low light
 
•	Curated Map Styles
Switch seamlessly between simple, detailed, hybrid and satellite maps
 
Help and Support
Plane Finder is regularly updated with innovative new features.  Please email support@planefinder.net with any questions or queries, we are happy to help.
 
How does Plane Finder work?
Plane Finder receives real time ADS-B and MLAT signals sent by aircraft to transmit their positional data to land based receivers. This technology is faster than traditional radar and is used for air traffic control and navigation. You can check our worldwide flight tracking coverage for free at www.planefinder.net

WHAT YOU GET

PROVEN RESULTS
Based on ~130,000 post-flight surveys:

JET LAG MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE
Jet lag cannot be fixed with generic sleep advice, exercise, hydration, dietary supplements, special diets or fasting. None of these reset your circadian clock quickly to a new time zone.

Light is the key time cue that resets your circadian clock. Individually-timed light exposure and light avoidance - based on your chronotype, your normal sleep pattern and your itinerary - is the only way to adjust to a new time zone quickly. Get the timing wrong and jet lag gets worse.

We built Timeshifter to make circadian science accessible and help you apply it to reduce jet lag. It targets the underlying cause of jet lag - the disruption of your circadian clock - and reduces the symptoms that come with it, including insomnia, daytime sleepiness, fatigue and digestive discomfort.

He is an international authority on circadian rhythms and sleep, with more than 30 years of clinical research experience in humans, and works with NASA astronauts and mission controllers, F1 teams, NBA players, national soccer teams and Olympic athletes.

Whether you are crossing one time zone or ten, on a long-haul flight or a quick turnaround, Timeshifter gives you a jet lag plan built for that trip.
